records.description_rewritten: The historical gay-szene entry refers specifically to the toilets inside Berlin's Prater beer garden at Kastanienallee 7–9, not to the separate venue or cultural gallery as a sex venue. The official operator confirms the beer garden is on winter break in November 2026, while the Gaststätte/restaurant remains open. There are only three forum comments on the original listing and no verified recent cruising activity. Former garden-WC access cannot be inferred from winter restaurant trading hours.

supplemental_sources.note: Original old directory labels garden toilets as cruising.
Official site says Biergarten winter pause and Gaststätte open.
Municipal venue identity and separate restaurant operations.

records.access_information: Biergarten seasonally CLOSED in November; restaurant open on its schedule; sanitary facilities for patrons follow house rules. Not a dedicated cruising venue.

records.description_rewritten: The source labels the communal showers at Stadtbad Mitte, the James Simon public swimming facility on Gartenstraße 5. Berliner Bäder-Betriebe provides an operating timetable from 31 August to 31 December 2026, with school and club reserved intervals as well as public swimming. It is a supervised public bath, not a gay sauna; claims about activity in changing or shower areas are unverified by a post-cutoff visitor report. Privacy and other visitors' consent are essential.

supplemental_sources.note: Original named communal shower reference with 32 old directory forum entries.
Official late-2026 opening schedule and public/school/club distinctions.

records.access_information: Paid public swimming facility, with strictly scheduled school/club-only hours, supervision and changing-area privacy. Public cruising is not permitted merely by its directory inclusion.
review_flags: Separate gender/shower and school/club users; no sex venue.
Operating schedule includes restricted periods; do not invent permanent open hours.

records.description_rewritten: Stadtbad Neukölln is a historic public indoor bath and sauna at Ganghoferstraße 3. The operator publishes swimming and sauna programmes for 2026–27; its redesigned sauna reopened in February 2026, and sauna programme resumed after October. Monday includes women's-only hours, and other days are mixed rather than men-only. Gay-szene.net archives the bath as a potential cruising location but does not prove sex activity or a separate gay darkroom.

supplemental_sources.note: Original historical gay cruising listing, location at Ganghoferstraße 3.
Operator's current 2026–27 swimming and sauna schedules; mixed and women's days.

records.access_information: Paid and supervised public indoor pool and sauna. Respect weekly women-only blocks, public-swimming reservations, staff supervision and privacy. No permission for sexual activity.
review_flags: Not a dedicated gay venue, not men-only.
Public sauna schedules differ by gender/day.

records.description_rewritten: Mahndorfer Marsch is an A1 motorway parking/rest area in Bremen near the Bremer Kreuz, on the direction toward Hemelingen. Gay-szene.net source users gave a dated 2 May 2026 firsthand report of visiting on 1 and 2 May and finding no activity, directly contradicting generic old 'busy' claims. An older 30 April 2023 post describes positive cruising and nearby toilets; this is historical. The original page references openings in fencing, which should not be interpreted as lawful woodland entry.

supplemental_sources.note: 2 May 2026 two unsuccessful visits; 2023 historical claims.
Original regional index and directional claim.

recent_dated_reports.detail: Visited 1–2 May, saw no cruising despite warm weather.
